_about: Public-domain Amos Stevens Billingsley (1818-1897), Presbyterian minister and army chaplain, for the Word Hoard: From the Flag to the Cross (Christianity in the Civil War) and his Life of George Whitefield. Texts are from Internet Archive scans. Added 2026-10-23 by lane A, round 102 (my pick); Adam may veto the whole shelf. Every printing dated before 1930, so public domain in the US. No uids minted.
